title: 600-Series Dependency Map
verdict: ACYCLIC — No circular dependencies. Pipeline architecture is sound but does not justify 600-series launch.

edges.type: DATA FORWARD — analytics informs authoring priorities
CONTENT FORWARD — pre-authored items for certification
DATA FORWARD (EXISTING) — UIQS rankings inform certification priority
REJECTION FEEDBACK (not a dependency — items return for re-author on cert failure)

cycle_detection.result: NO CYCLES. Directed acyclic graph confirmed.
cycle_detection.explanation: 800→600 is a content re-entry loop (same item re-processed), not an ownership dependency. 600 does not depend on 800 rejecting items to function.

audit_results: 600 needs analytics → all S302-S306 analytics exist and are complete
800 needs pre-authored EW → 800 can still certify without pre-authored EW (current model)
300 needs 600 output for analytics → 300 operates on pack files, not 600 artifacts
600 needs 800 certification to know what to author → 300's UIQS identifies EW-need independently

handoff_protocol.design: 600→800 handoff requires: pre-cert QA gate (automated scans), 800 independent re-derivation of CC, 600-prepared metadata flag, ≤28 item batch at handoff boundary
handoff_protocol.risk: Anchoring bias — 800 certifiers may assume 600-prepared content is correct, eroding CAQS §1.6 independence

recommendation: Architecture is valid but does not overcome the throughput deficit. DEFER 600-series. If launched in future, the handoff protocol must include mandatory independent re-derivation by 800.
